'''Elodd Fask''' was a rancher on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedesia]] and a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Fask's ranch was a safe landing zone for Alliance operatives. Fask and their family were all [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[FNV-23|Gray Death]] plague.
